intent: Send invoice and business reason to buyer.
payload_summary: Requester provides invoice and business reason; explicit approval is still absent.

intent: Ask for timely processing without approval authority.
payload_summary: Vendor asks for speed but does not approve payment.

intent: Ask approver to clarify approval status.
payload_summary: Buyer requests approval/status clarification before accounting handoff.
Service continuity is time-sensitive, but no explicit approval has been recorded.
expected_effect: buyer receives unresolved G001/G002 evidence-gap record that is not explicit approval

intent: Route the case to accounting for review/handling while preserving the unresolved approval and exception-authority gaps, so the next control decision can be made without implying authorization to pay.
payload_summary: Handoff packet: invoice and business reason are present, but explicit approval (G001) and valid exception authority (G002) remain unresolved. Approver provided ambiguous guidance; unresolved gap record ER01 notes service continuity is time-sensitive but is not explicit approval. Request accounting to review and determine proper next step (e.g., require explicit approval/exception authority or place on hold) before any payment processing.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present in the case materials.
Approver response did not provide explicit approval; gaps G001 and G002 remain unresolved per recorded decision/state delta.
Unresolved evidence-gap record ER01 exists and must remain distinguishable from explicit approval.
expected_effect: Accounting receives the case with clear flags that approval/exception authority are unresolved, enabling them to hold or request proper authorization rather than treating the handoff or urgency as approval.
risk_flags: ER01 service continuity urgency is not approval; risk of misinterpretation if not highlighted
Potential for premature payment if gaps are overlooked

intent: Obtain traceable explicit approval or documented valid exception authority before any payment preparation, while preserving the unresolved approval/exception gaps recorded in the handoff.
payload_summary: Accounting cannot proceed to prepare payment based on the local packet: invoice and business reason are present, but explicit approval (G001) and valid exception authority (G002) remain unresolved; ER01 notes service continuity urgency but is not approval. Please provide (a) the explicit approver approval record for this invoice/payment OR (b) a documented exception authorization that clearly grants authority to proceed without standard approval, with references that can be filed for audit.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present in local records
Local packet indicates explicit approval (G001) is missing/unresolved
Local packet indicates valid exception authority (G002) is missing/unresolved
Service-continuity urgency (ER01) is explicitly not approval and cannot be used as authorization
expected_effect: Buyer supplies missing approval or exception-authorization evidence (or confirms none exists), enabling the next control decision (prepare payment vs hold vs escalate/exception review) without implying authorization from ambiguity or urgency.
risk_flags: ER01 service continuity urgency is not approval; risk of misinterpretation if not highlighted
Potential for premature payment if gaps are overlooked
